comment: Boards for hwtest/make_hwtest.mjs. Each board starts from the configurator's own 'Load example' for the chip and package (LED, UART, ADC, PWM / TMR0 on real pins), keeps uart/adc/timer/gpio, and adds a 1 kHz timer interrupt. pins: {"PA9": "USART1_TX"} re-assigns pins like a click in the pinout view (use it to match your board's LED or USB-serial pins). irqTimer: CH32 timer for the interrupt test (default: a timer not used by the PWM). ch5xxPwm: PWMX channel the test itself sets up on CH5xx (the configurator has no CH5xx PWM option).
